ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering >95% of the visible surface; localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters are confined to the distal tips and specific scar points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters located at the extreme left and right distal tips. A distinct circular high-contrast ring-shaped feature is located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees, bisecting the two primary lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 25 pixels in depth relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward-sweeping convex curves originating from the median notch and terminating at the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the superior and lateral edges of both lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct, diagonal linear pixel disruption (white scratch) located on the right lobe, oriented approximately 30 degrees from the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation on the distal margins of both fluke lobes; distinctive circular 'ring' scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, closed-loop circular scar on the left lobe surface near the upper margin, approximately 1/4 the distance from the notch to the tip.
